overview: 今日共收录60篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Ab initio Modeling of MoS2/Oxide Device Interfaces with Machine Learned Electronic Structures
full_list.title_zh: 利用机器学习电子结构对MoS2/氧化物器件界面进行第一性原理建模
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于模拟半导体器件的第一性原理方法，将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进量子输运求解器相结合。该框架在保持较高预测精度的同时，可将器件哈密顿矩阵的生成速度提高约10000倍，并处理含有超过20000个原子的器件。作者将其应用于显式纳入氧化物层的MoS2/氧化物样品和单层MoS2场效应晶体管，揭示了界面附近配位不足的Hf或Al金属原子对电子流大小及其在MoS2中传播的显著影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于模拟半导体器件的全新第一性原理方法，将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进的量子输运求解器相结合。所开发的框架能够以比密度泛函理论快10000倍的速度，为由超过20000个原子组成的器件生成哈密顿矩阵，同时保持较高的预测精度。我们利用该框架的独特功能研究了MoS2/氧化物样品和单层MoS2场效应晶体管，其中周围的氧化物层，即HfO2或Al2O3，被显式纳入量子输运计算区域。特别是，我们揭示了靠近半导体-氧化物界面的配位不足金属原子（Hf或Al）的存在，会显著影响电子流的大小及其在MoS2中的传播。
full_list.summary: 本文提出一种用于模拟半导体器件的第一性原理方法，将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进量子输运求解器相结合。该框架在保持较高预测精度的同时，可将器件哈密顿矩阵的生成速度提高约10000倍，并处理含有超过20000个原子的器件。作者将其应用于显式纳入氧化物层的MoS2/氧化物样品和单层MoS2场效应晶体管，揭示了界面附近配位不足的Hf或Al金属原子对电子流大小及其在MoS2中传播的显著影响。
authors: Manasa Kaniselvan, Mauro Dossena, Denghui Lu, Alexander Maeder, Nicolas Vetsch, Alexandros Nikolaos Ziogas, Mathieu Luisier
full_list.focus_summary: 论文提出将机器学习电子结构模型与量子输运求解器结合，用于大规模半导体器件界面的阿贝 initio 模拟，并实现相对密度泛函理论显著加速。以 MoS2/HfO2、MoS2/Al2O3 和单层 MoS2 场效应晶体管为例，揭示界面附近配位不足的金属原子会显著影响电子电流及其在 MoS2 中的传播。
full_list.focus_relation: 该工作直接对应我们的机器学习电子哈密顿量、机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量、量子输运、二维半导体和异质结构界面方向。其大体系哈密顿量预测与输运计算框架具有很强的方法学借鉴价值，也与 HfO2 材料体系存在直接交集。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其机器学习哈密顿量的训练表示、外推稳定性和量子输运耦合方式。进一步可研究含缺陷、应变、极化态或磁性界面的 MoS2/HfO2 器件，并结合主动学习提升界面构型覆盖能力。
full_list.method_point: 文章将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与量子输运求解器耦合，直接生成器件哈密顿量并用于MoS2/氧化物界面及单层MoS2场效应管，报告相对第一性原理哈密顿量生成约10,000倍加速且可处理超过20,000原子。模型显式保留Hf或Al氧化物层及界面欠配位金属，随后由输运求解器计算电子流及其在MoS2中的传播。摘要没有说明采用Wannier基、图网络类型、NEGF边界、自能或电荷自洽方式，复现必须补齐这些决定传输可信度的设置。
full_list.related_work: 这比用MACE或NEP预测能量和力更接近器件级电子结构学习，与DeepH、Wannier tight-binding学习和NEGF-DFT路线相呼应。核心差异是把原子尺度缺陷直接传播到可观测电流，而非仅报告能带。团队五位成员的ML电子结构、二维材料、氧化物界面、铁电调控和输运计算能力可形成完整链条；对CrI3、CrSBr等磁性隧穿结，还需扩展至SOC和自旋分辨哈密顿量，不能套用无自旋MoS2模型。
full_list.implication: 可优先搭建MoS2/HfO2与NbOI2/氧化物两套小尺寸DFT基准，枚举氧空位、欠配位Hf/Al、吸附氢、栅压等效电场和不同界面距离，输出局域轨道哈密顿量、重叠矩阵及NEGF透射。用图网络学习矩阵元时强制厄米性、旋转协变性和长程静电校正，再扩展到万原子器件；以留出缺陷构型的DFT-NEGF I-V、扫描隧穿谱和接触电阻趋势验证。对铁电栅控，可比较BaTiO3或NbOI2正反极化下的势垒和电流开关比。

full_list.title_en: Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using advanced density functional theory, this study demonstrates the robust thermodynamic, structural, and dynamical stability of pristine, 3d-doped (Ti, Cr), and 4f-doped (Ce) transition metal trichlorides (MCl3). While standard generalized gradient approximation (GGA) incorrectly predicts metallic behavior, hybrid functional calculations successfully capture their semiconducting nature, yielding accurate band gaps of 2.54 eV (VCl3), 4.01 eV (CrCl3), and 2.61 eV (TiCl3). These materials exhibit intrinsic ferromagnetism, with CrCl3 displaying overlapping topological features in both its magnon and phonon dispersions along the high-symmetry K direction, which induces magnon-phonon coupling. Incorporating 3d dopants into VCl3 successfully tunes the bandgap (1.32 eV for Ti and 2.74 eV for Cr) without destroying ferromagnetism, while 4f Ce-doping in CrCl3 introduces localized states below the Fermi level that yield strong nearest-neighbor exchange coupling. Ultimately, this electronic and magnetic tunability highlights the potential of these 2D trichlorides in advanced spintronic functionalities.

authors: Krishna Prasad Chapai, Yogendra Limbu, Gopi Chandra Kaphle, Durga Paudyal
full_list.focus_summary: 该研究基于密度泛函理论和杂化泛函计算二维三氯化物的结构稳定性、电子结构、磁性及磁振子性质，并研究Ti、Cr和Ce掺杂对带隙和交换作用的调控。结果显示这些材料具有本征铁磁性，CrCl3中还存在磁振子-声子耦合及潜在拓扑特征。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的二维范德华磁体、磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋哈密顿量、磁振子-声子耦合和自旋电子学方向直接相关。其掺杂调控电子结构与交换相互作用的方法，可用于发展二维磁性材料设计和自旋输运研究。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步计算不同磁构型下的交换参数、磁各向异性、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和有限温度磁相变，并构建自旋哈密顿量结合蒙特卡洛模拟。还可使用声子与磁振子谱、非绝热动力学或自旋-晶格动力学定量研究磁振子-声子耦合及磁阻尼。
full_list.method_point: 该研究以二维过渡金属三氯化物MCl3及Ti、Cr等3d和Ce等4f掺杂体系为对象，先以先进DFT检查热力学、结构和动力学稳定性，再比较GGA与混合泛函的能带、磁交换和磁振子性质。其核心结论是GGA会把相关体系误判为金属，而混合泛函恢复绝缘电子结构；摘要没有列出具体M、HSE混合比例、U值、k网格或自旋哈密顿量拟合式，不能补造数值。
full_list.related_work: 这与CrI3、CrGeTe3和CrSBr中依靠SOC、交换各向异性及配体超交换解释二维磁性的研究相呼应，也说明只用PBE标签训练的ML模型会系统继承带隙与交换误差。团队五位成员中做二维磁性和DFT+U者可直接比较卤化物与硫卤化物，做MLIP者可处理掺杂构型，做铁电和界面者可考察电场或基底应变，做实验关联者可匹配磁振子谱。它不是一篇ML建模论文，ML切入点应定位在高阶DFT数据增广。
full_list.implication: 建议以CrI3、CrSBr及候选MCl3建立分层标签：大批PBE+SOC用于结构与力，小批HSE或经校准DFT+U用于带隙、交换常数J、单离子各向异性D和磁各向异性能。用equivariant GNN拟合势能面，并另建多任务模型学习局域环境到J、D的映射；在应变、掺杂浓度和温度扫描中结合自旋-晶格Monte Carlo。验证应包含HSE留出集、Raman软模、MOKE居里温度及非弹性散射磁振子色散，而非只比较基态磁序。

full_list.title_en: Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 to formate on copper is a key elementary step for CO2 utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present accurate dynamical predictions for CO2 hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on a full-dimensional first-principles neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as CO2 accesses the transition state. This mode-specific mechanistic insight revises the conventional interpretation and lays the foundation for the precise control of CO2 hydrogenation on catalysts.

authors: Junfan Xia, Zhikai Jiang, Yaolong Zhang, Bo Peng, Hua Guo, Bin Jiang
full_list.focus_summary: 论文利用全维度第一性原理神经网络势研究Cu(111)表面CO₂加氢制甲酸的反应动力学。结果表明，弯曲振动能够增强反应活性，但旋转激发及分子极性取向各向异性的变化对喷嘴温度引起的活性增强起主导作用。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队发展的机器学习势、第一性原理分子动力学、非绝热或反应动力学模拟高度相关，也涉及表面催化、能量转移和振动态选择性。虽然材料体系偏向催化表面，但方法和动力学问题具有直接借鉴价值。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可将类似的全维神经网络势和状态分辨动力学方法拓展到光催化界面、卤化物钙钛矿表面或等离激元辅助反应。进一步纳入电子激发和电荷转移，研究非绝热效应对反应选择性的影响。
full_list.method_point: 该研究针对Cu表面CO2加氢至甲酸根的基元反应，进行态分辨动力学预测，重点检验分子转动而非仅CO2弯曲振动对Eley-Rideal反应的隐蔽作用。摘要表明作者使用高精度动力学计算获得不同初始内态下的反应结果，适合解析入射取向、转动角动量与反应几率的关系；但未披露势能面来源、量子或准经典动力学方案、Cu晶面、温度及入射能，不能把它笼统称为MLIP研究。
full_list.related_work: 它与用神经网络势能面进行反应分子动力学、表面振动态选择化学和CO2电催化微观动力学相接，但其突出点是将转动自由度作为可控反应坐标。团队五位成员的ML势函数、氧化物界面、铁电极化、二维材料和实验谱学方向可借鉴其“模式分辨”思路：在BaTiO3表面或极化二维材料上，吸附物取向和表面声子同样可能决定反应选择性。它与凝聚态磁性主题关联较弱，应作为ML势和非平衡动力学的方法参考。
full_list.implication: 若迁移到团队的铁电催化体系，可选BaTiO3(001)或NbOI2表面的CO2、H2O和H吸附，分别建立正负极化、氧空位和覆盖度条件下的DFT势能面数据。先用主动学习的MACE/NEP拟合含表面原子、吸附物转动和反应过渡态的势，再以准经典轨线或环聚合物动力学扫描入射取向、转动态和表面温度。验证应比较DFT过渡态势垒、同位素效应、偏振红外或程序升温脱附产物比，并将极化翻转前后的模式选择性作为明确实验判据。

full_list.title_en: Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2502.17050v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to grain boundaries (GBs) significantly impacts material behavior, with most studies focusing on substitutional solute segregation while neglecting interstitial segregation due to its increased complexity. The site preference, interstitial or substitutional, for P segregation in α-Fe still remains under debate. This work investigates both substitutional and interstitial GB segregation in a polycrystalline model using classical interatomic potentials and machine learning. The method is validated with H and Ni, whose segregation behaviors are well understood. For P, we find segregation to both GB site types, with a preference for substitutional sites based on mean segregation energy. However, the abundance of interstitial sites means interstitial segregation also significantly contributes to the GB enrichment with P. This highlights the importance of considering interstitial P segregation alongside substitutional segregation. Additionally, obtaining a representative spectrum of segregation energies is crucial for accurate, experimentally aligned predictions.

authors: Amin Reiners-Sakic, Alexander Reichmann, Christoph Dösinger, Lorenz Romaner, David Holec
full_list.focus_summary: 论文研究了多晶α-Fe中磷在晶界替位和间隙位点上的偏聚行为，结合经典原子间势与机器学习方法分析不同类型晶界位点的偏聚能分布。结果表明，磷平均上偏好替位，但由于间隙位点数量丰富，间隙偏聚也会显著贡献晶界富集。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的半导体和功能材料缺陷、晶界、缺陷形成能、机器学习势及主动学习方向高度相关。其同时考虑多类缺陷位点和代表性偏聚能谱的思路，可用于改进缺陷统计和复杂界面建模。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步用第一性原理校准磷及其他杂质在代表性晶界中的形成能、迁移能垒和电荷态效应，并构建含长程相互作用的机器学习势。还可研究温度、应力和辐照条件下的动态偏聚过程。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Band-like Carriers in a Soft, Anharmonic Lattice: Lead-Halide Perovskites
full_list.title_zh: 软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-halide perovskites APbX3 present a striking dichotomy: they exhibit band-like electronic transport despite their exceptionally soft and anharmonic lattices. Optically and electrically, they resemble conventional direct-gap semiconductors, exhibiting light carrier masses and steep absorption onsets, whereas their lattices display liquid-like dynamics, including overdamped octahedral motions, quasielastic Raman central peaks, and exceptionally low thermal conductivities. Solution-processed films nevertheless sustain micrometre-scale carrier diffusion at defect densities that would severely suppress transport in conventional semiconductors. Here, we argue that these apparently disparate properties emerge from a common microscopic framework: a soft, strongly anharmonic, and polar [PbX3]- framework, strongly influenced by the Pb 6s2 lone pair, which simultaneously shapes the antibonding orbital character of the band edges, the magnitude and multiple timescales of the dielectric response, and the slow relaxational dynamics that dress every charge carrier. We therefore invert the conventional order and develop the lattice before the electronic structure, because the nominally cubic phase is better viewed as a thermally fluctuating ensemble of locally symmetry-broken configurations rather than a single geometry. Within this framework, we discuss excitons, Frohlich large polarons in the intermediate-coupling regime, carrier transport, defect tolerance, dimensional reduction in two-dimensional and nanocrystalline derivatives, and symmetry-breaking phenomena. We critically assess three contested issues - defect tolerance, ferroelectricity, and the interpretation of the T-3/2 mobility law - and identify seven open questions together with the key measurements needed to resolve them
full_list.abstract_zh: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3具有显著矛盾性：其晶格极软且强非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运和较长的载流子扩散距离。本文提出统一微观图像，认为受Pb 6s2孤对电子强烈影响的软、强非谐且极性的[PbX3]-骨架，同时决定带边反键轨道、介电响应与载流子弛豫动力学。文章据此讨论激子、大Fröhlich极化子、输运、缺陷容忍性及对称性破缺，并评估若干争议问题和开放问题。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3呈现出显著的二分性：尽管其晶格异常柔软且高度非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运。在光学和电学性质上，它们类似于传统直接带隙半导体，表现出较轻的载流子有效质量和陡峭的吸收边；而其晶格却呈现液体般的动力学，包括过阻尼八面体运动、准弹性拉曼中心峰和异常低的热导率。尽管缺陷密度在传统半导体中会严重抑制输运，溶液法制备的薄膜仍可维持微米尺度的载流子扩散。本文认为，这些表面上彼此割裂的性质源于一个共同的微观框架：柔软、强非谐且具有极性的[PbX3]-骨架受到Pb 6s2孤对电子的强烈影响，并同时塑造带边的反键轨道特征、介电响应的幅度与多个时间尺度，以及修饰每个电荷载流子的缓慢弛豫动力学。因此，我们颠倒了通常的论述顺序，先讨论晶格后讨论电子结构，因为名义上的立方相更适合被看作局域对称性破缺构型的热涨落系综，而非单一几何构型。在这一框架内，我们讨论了激子、中等耦合区间的Fröhlich大极化子、载流子输运、缺陷容忍性、二维和纳米晶衍生物中的维度降低，以及对称性破缺现象。我们批判性评估了三个有争议的问题，即缺陷容忍性、铁电性和T⁻³/2迁移率定律的解释，并确定了七个开放问题及解决它们所需的关键测量。

authors: Young Mi Lee, Inhee Maeng, Jinwoo Park, Seung-Jae Oh, Min-Cherl Jung
full_list.focus_summary: 论文研究铅卤钙钛矿中带状载流子输运与软性、强非谐极性晶格之间的关系。主要结论是，Pb 6s2 孤对电子塑造了能带边、介电响应和晶格弛豫动力学，从而使材料在低热导和强晶格涨落下仍保持较好的载流子扩散与输运特性。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的卤化物钙钛矿、载流子输运、电子-声子耦合、热载流子弛豫和非绝热动力学方向高度相关。其关于强非谐晶格、极化屏蔽和载流子-晶格耦合的统一图像，可为第一性原理分子动力学、声子重整化及输运计算提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合非绝热分子动力学或电子-声子耦合计算，定量研究软晶格对迁移率、载流子寿命和热载流子弛豫的影响。也可利用机器学习势扩展到有限温度、大尺度和含缺陷体系。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dilute-Limit Defect Displacements Enabled by Brillouin-Zone Sampling
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dilute-Limit Defect Displacements Enabled by Brillouin-Zone Sampling
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defects and their interaction with the semiconductor host lattice play an essential role in a variety of technologies. When a defect transitions between two electronic states, the lattice distorts in response. Large displacements occur near the defect, inducing displacements on neighboring atoms, and so on, producing small displacements on atoms hundreds of Ångströms from the defect. Describing these displacements accurately is challenging for first-principles calculations due to limited supercell sizes. Here we demonstrate a procedure to efficiently obtain dilute-limit atomic displacements, using information obtained in typical modest supercells. In our approach, the atomic displacements are first obtained in a small supercell and converted into a force difference under a harmonic potential energy surface. The force difference and phonon modes at different bf q-points are then unfolded into the Born-von Kármán supercell to obtain the dilute-limit atomic displacements. We critically analyze the convergence behavior of the force difference and study possible electron density differences that give rise to those forces, arguing that modest supercells are sufficient for internal transitions and bound-exciton transitions. Two example applications of our approach are given: (1) we calculate the luminescence spectrum of the NV center in diamond and the T center in Si and (2) we obtain dilute-limit configuration coordinate diagrams for these defects. In particular, we find that coupling to acoustic phonon modes reduces the accepting-mode frequency in the configuration coordinate diagram. Our work provides the missing ingredients necessary to address truly dilute-limit transitions at defects.

full_list.title_en: Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.23570v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stacking two sheets of graphene with a slight twist or lattice mismatch produces a moiré pattern that self-organizes into a network of one-dimensional channels, or domain walls, known to conduct electrons with low dissipation - a property attractive for low-power electronics. We show that these channels are not always straight: as the graphene lattice relaxes to minimize strain, the network can spontaneously curve into chiral configurations. Using atomistic simulations, we map a phase diagram in which the local balance of strain and flexibility selects one of three stable shapes-straight, mono-chiral, or dual-chiral, curving to one or both sides. Electronic structure calculations show that this geometric choice controls where low-energy electrons accumulate. Straight channels concentrate electronic states at points where differently stacked regions meet, with balanced conduction on both sides of a domain wall. Chiral channels instead redirect that electronic weight onto the domain walls themselves, favouring one side over the other and breaking up the smooth wave patterns seen in straight channels. This purely geometric effect acts as a switch, letting the same moiré material support either localised electronic hot spots or directional one-dimensional conducting channels - two distinct strategies for guiding electrons in future low-power graphene devices.

full_list.title_en: DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.14603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to interfaces significantly impacts material behavior. A large majority of theoretical works focus on grain boundaries and coherent interfaces. Studies on semi-coherent interfaces are usually prohibited by the structural complexity, yielding models beyond the practical capability of density functional theory (DFT), or chemical complexity, restricted by the availability of (classical) interatomic potentials. This work investigates solute segregation to the coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interface in pearlite and its effect on mechanical properties using novel universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). DFT calculated solution enthalpies, segregation energetics, and changes in cohesion at the coherent interface are used to benchmark several state-of-the-art uMLIPs. We find that the GRACE-2L-OAM and GRACE-2L-OMAT models most accurately reproduce the quantum-mechanical predictions. While Cu has the strongest segregation energy of approx -0.3 eV to the coherent interface among the investigated tramp and trace elements, all of them, As, Cr, Cu, Mo, Ni, P, Sb, and Sn, exhibit significantly more negative segregation values reaching below approx -1.5 eV in the presence of the misfit dislocation at the semi-coherent interface. The deepest traps are identified in the vicinity of the dislocation core, although the spatial distribution of segregation energies differs markedly among the solute species. The cohesion of the coherent interface is strongly reduced by Sb, Sn, P, and As, and only mildly by Cu, whereas Ni shows a negligible effect, and Cr and Mo slightly enhance cohesion. In contrast, all investigated solutes (except for P) tend to embrittle the semi-coherent interface, with Sn and, especially, Sb having the strongest impact in tensile tests performed in the out-of-plane direction. Abstract shortened for ArXiv.

full_list.focus_summary: 该工作结合密度泛函理论与通用机器学习原子间势，研究珠光体中相干及半相干α-Fe/Fe3C界面的溶质偏聚和界面结合强度变化。作者以DFT偏聚能和溶解焓为基准评估多种模型，发现部分通用机器学习势能够较好重现量子力学预测。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、第一性原理计算和材料界面/缺陷研究方向相关，但研究对象偏向钢铁材料而非团队重点功能材料。其以关键界面能量学量基准化验证通用势函数的流程，可借鉴到铁电畴壁、异质结界面或电池材料界面。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可关注其半相干界面结构构建和机器学习势验证策略，并将类似方法用于HfO2畴壁缺陷偏聚或范德华异质结中的离子迁移。后续可进一步考察偏聚对局域磁性、极化和输运性质的影响。
full_list.method_point: 工作以α-Fe/Fe3C共格及半共格界面为对象，将DFT用于生成不同溶质、界面位点和局域弛豫状态的能量标注，再以MLIP扩展到含失配位错的超大原子模型，计算偏析能及其位点分布。摘要未给出势函数家族、截断半径、训练集规模和泛函设置，不能将其误称为MACE或NEP；关键方法学价值是用MLIP保留原子弛豫，同时覆盖半共格界面的长周期结构复杂性。
full_list.related_work: 该路线对应合金界面中“DFT小胞校准、MLIP大胞采样”的多尺度范式，区别于只计算理想晶界或共格异质结的静态DFT。它与团队五位成员中铁电畴壁与缺陷、二维磁性层间滑移、氧化物界面电荷、机器学习势和高通量DFT五条既有工作线分别共享局域化学、长程应变、界面重构、势函数外推和标注闭环问题。对CrI3或BaTiO3而言，可迁移的是半共格界面采样逻辑，不是Fe-C势参数本身。
full_list.implication: 可先为BaTiO3/SrTiO3失配界面或CrSBr/氧化物接触面建立含台阶、氧空位和不同终止面的DFT+U标注池，标签至少含能量、力、应力及局域磁矩或Born有效电荷。以equivariant GNN或MACE训练后，在数万原子胞中退火并计算缺陷偏聚自由能；用保留的DFT位点能、STEM可见位错间距及PFM或MOKE空间分布三重验证。五位成员可分别负责结构枚举、DFT、MLIP主动学习、有限温采样和实验对照。

full_list.title_en: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
full_list.title_zh: 电荷转移与竞争性对称性破缺驱动绝缘氧化物超晶格中的轨道重构和涌现铁磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3d transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO₃ with Mott-insulating NdMnO₃. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO₃ to NdNiO₃ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role. These reconstructions stabilize an emergent ferromagnetic insulating state arising from interfacial Ni²⁺-O-Mn⁴⁺ superexchange. Our results establish a pathway to interface-engineered ferromagnetic insulating phases via competing interactions, with potential for spin-insulatronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联、跃迁以及配体至金属的电荷转移共同导致3d过渡金属氧化物中多样的电子和磁性现象；在这些材料中，具有方向性的d轨道使跃迁对依赖对称性的轨道重叠高度敏感。具有原子级平整界面的异质结构工程，将由对称性破缺引起的电荷转移作为获得涌现行为的另一条途径；然而，超晶格组分氧化物之间的界面失配是否能独立于外延应变而塑造基态，仍未得到解决。本文考察了结合NdNiO3和Mott绝缘体NdMnO3的超晶格。通过改变层厚度并结合输运测量与X射线谱学，我们表明，从NdMnO3向NdNiO3的电子转移驱动了室温绝缘态及其独特电子结构，同时伴随超出简单应变考量的轨道对称性反转，凸显了界面的核心作用。这些重构稳定了一种涌现的铁磁绝缘态，该态源于界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换。我们的结果确立了通过竞争相互作用获得界面工程化铁磁绝缘相的路径，并有望应用于自旋绝缘电子学。
full_list.summary: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
authors: Nandana Bhattacharya, Ranjan Kumar Patel, Siddharth Kumar, Sourav Chowdhury, Manav Beniwal, Suresh Chandra Joshi, Prithwijit Mandal, Jayjit Kumar Dey, Weibin Li, Manuel Valvidares, Zhan Zhang, Hua Zhou, Andrei Gloskovskii, Christoph Schlueter, Christoph Klewe, Srimanta Middey
full_list.focus_summary: 论文研究 NdNiO3/NdMnO3 氧化物超晶格中的界面电荷转移、轨道重构和对称性破缺。研究发现，NdMnO3 向 NdNiO3 的电子转移可形成室温绝缘态，并通过 Ni2+-O-Mn4+ 超交换稳定界面诱导的铁磁绝缘态。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、磁性超晶格、界面电荷转移、轨道重构和自旋相关相互作用方向相关。虽然工作以实验表征为主，但其界面诱导磁性和超交换机制适合用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量及蒙特卡洛方法进一步解析。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议开展不同层厚、应变和界面终止条件下的第一性原理计算，分离电荷转移、晶格失配与应变对磁基态的贡献。还可提取交换参数和磁各向异性，研究温度依赖的界面磁序。
full_list.method_point: 文章以NdNiO3/NdMnO3绝缘氧化物超晶格为平台，通过改变各层厚度，联合输运测量和X射线谱学追踪界面电子转移、轨道对称性与磁序。其物理路线是NdMnO3向NdNiO3的电荷转移形成Ni2+-O-Mn4+键，由界面超交换稳定铁磁绝缘态；层厚调控用于区分电荷重构、外延应变和竞争性对称性破缺。摘要未说明具体谱学边、DFT泛函或是否用了DFT+U，因此不能把实验归因替换为未经报告的计算参数。
full_list.related_work: 它直接呼应LaNiO3/LaMnO3、镍酸盐金属-绝缘体转变和氧化物界面双交换/超交换研究，但强调轨道反转不能单由应变解释。团队五位成员的氧化物界面、铁电极化、DFT+U、ML势和磁学表征方向可在同一问题会合：BaTiO3极化可改变界面电荷，机器学习可枚举终止面与八面体旋转，磁学成员可检验交换符号。与CrI3类范德瓦耳斯磁体相比，这里必须显式处理氧配体、价态和八面体畸变。
full_list.implication: 可将NdNiO3/NdMnO3作为团队的界面基准，构造不同层厚、A/O终止、氧空位、应变和八面体倾转的DFT+U数据，标签包含电荷密度差、轨道投影、局域磁矩、交换能及极化。先用主动学习MACE搜索低能重构，再对候选结构做DFT+U或DMFT复算，并以STEM-EELS价态剖面、XLD轨道各向异性、温变电阻和XMCD验证。随后引入BaTiO3层，在正负极化状态比较电荷转移与居里温度，实现可开关检验。

full_list.title_en: Interplay between crystal structure and magnetism in CeCrB₄
full_list.title_zh: CeCrB₄ 中晶体结构与磁性的相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CeCrB₄ belongs to the family of MTB₄ ternary metal borides, some of whose magnetic phases have recently been identified as quantum spin dimers. Employing density functional theory within the GGA+U framework, this work investigates the key ground-state properties of this system, including its ferromagnetic ground state, the mixed-valence nature of cerium, and the charge transfer from the cationic cerium--chromium layers to the anionic boron layers. In particular, we focus on elucidating the bonding mechanism within the structurally embedded Cr-Cr dimers. Specifically, we evaluate a previously proposed interpretation that the localized Cr 3dz^₂ states are molecular-like bonding and antibonding states. The calculated dependence of the 3dz^₂ electronic structure on the intra-dimer distance correlates with the level-splitting characteristics known for classical homonuclear diatomic molecules.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: CeCrB₄ 属于 MTB₄ 三元金属硼化物家族，该家族中的一些磁性相最近被确定为量子自旋二聚体。本文在 GGA+U 框架下采用密度泛函理论，研究了该体系的关键基态性质，包括其铁磁基态、铈的混合价性质，以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。特别地，我们着重阐明结构中嵌入的 Cr-Cr 二聚体内部的成键机制。具体而言，我们评估了此前提出的一种解释，即局域化的 Cr 3d_z² 态是分子型成键态和反键态。计算得到的 3d_z² 电子结构对二聚体内距离的依赖关系，与经典同核双原子分子中已知的能级分裂特征相吻合。
full_list.summary: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
authors: Mirosław Werwiński, Andrzej Szajek, Andrzej Kowalczyk
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作采用GGA+U密度泛函计算研究CeCrB4的晶体结构、铁磁基态、铈混合价态及层间电荷转移。作者进一步分析Cr-Cr二聚体内3dz2轨道的成键与反键分裂，并揭示其对二聚体间距的依赖关系。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理磁性材料、电子结构和自旋相互作用研究相关，尤其涉及关联电子、磁序和局域成键机制。研究体系不是团队当前重点，但其针对磁性基态和轨道分裂的分析框架具有借鉴价值。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可阅读其U值处理、价态判定和磁构型比较方法，并考虑以Wannier化和交换参数映射补充其磁相互作用分析。后续可研究结构调控或压力下Cr二聚体变化是否诱导磁相变或拓扑电子态。
full_list.method_point: 该工作使用GGA+U研究CeCrB4的铁磁基态、Ce混合价、电荷由Ce-Cr阳离子层向B层转移，以及Cr-Cr二聚体中的Cr 3d_z2成键。方法重点不是仅比较铁磁和反铁磁总能，而是随二聚体内Cr-Cr距离追踪3d_z2态的成键/反键分裂，并与同核双原子分子能级演化对照。摘要未给出U、J、SOC、结构优化约束和价态分析方法，Ce的强关联结论需对这些设置做敏感性测试。
full_list.related_work: 它与Ce基重费米子或混合价化合物、过渡金属二聚化及磁-晶格耦合研究相连，也与CrSBr中Cr轨道占据影响交换路径的讨论形成对照。团队五位成员中做强关联DFT者可校准U和双计数，磁性者可拟合交换，ML电子结构者可学习局域轨道描述符，铁电与结构成员可施加应变，实验成员可关联磁化和XAS。不同于单纯原子坐标MLIP，这一问题要求保留轨道占据和价态信息。
full_list.implication: 可将Cr-Cr键长作为受控反应坐标，为CeCrB4及团队关注的CrSBr/CrI3受压结构计算DFT+U+SOC能量、力、投影态密度、Wannier跃迁和交换常数。训练时用局域环境equivariant GNN预测势能，同时以多任务头预测d轨道占据、键级代理量和J；对未见应变与二聚距离实施不确定性采样。用高压XRD的键长、XAS/XMCD价态及磁化或中子散射交换尺度验证，并检查不同U下结论是否稳健。

full_list.title_en: Significant modulation of acoustoelectric current associated with charge density wave transitions
full_list.title_zh: 与电荷密度波相变相关的声电流显著调制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We studied acoustoelectric (AE) currents in materials that undergo charge density wave (CDW) transitions, induced by a surface acoustic wave (SAW) on a piezoelectric substrate. The polarity and magnitude of the AE current in NbSe₃ and 2H-TaSe₂ were modulated due to their CDW transitions. We also found that the sign of the AE current depends on the SAW propagation direction with respect to the crystalline axis of the substrate.A phenomenological model assuming strain-modified conductivity can qualitatively account for the significant modulation of the AE current associated with the CDW transition, as well as the SAW propagation orientation dependence. The present results offer a powerful probe for exploring SAW-electron interactions in van der Waals materials, thereby highlighting their potential for advancing the emerging field of straintronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究考察了压电衬底表面声波诱导的、经历电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的声电流极性与幅值均会随CDW相变而调制，且其符号取决于表面声波相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些现象，显示该方法可用于研究范德华材料中的表面声波-电子相互作用及应变电子学。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在压电衬底上由表面声波（SAW）诱导的、发生电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流（AE电流）。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的AE电流极性和大小均因其CDW相变而受到调制。我们还发现，AE电流的符号取决于SAW相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。假定电导率受应变修饰的唯象模型，可以定性解释与CDW相变相关的AE电流显著调制，以及对SAW传播取向的依赖性。目前结果为探索范德华材料中的SAW-电子相互作用提供了有力探针，并凸显了其推动新兴应变电子学领域发展的潜力。
full_list.summary: 研究考察了压电衬底表面声波诱导的、经历电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的声电流极性与幅值均会随CDW相变而调制，且其符号取决于表面声波相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些现象，显示该方法可用于研究范德华材料中的表面声波-电子相互作用及应变电子学。
authors: Natsumi Nikaido, Takuya Kawada, Koji Fujiwara, Jihoon Park, Nan Jiang, Kouta Kondou, Shintaro Takada, Yasuhiro Niimi
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作测量NbSe3和2H-TaSe2在电荷密度波转变附近的声电流，发现声表面波诱导电流的大小和极性会被显著调制，且依赖于传播方向与晶轴的相对取向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些结果。
full_list.focus_relation: 该工作与团队的范德华材料、电荷密度波、应变工程、输运和电子-声子耦合研究相关。其利用声表面波探测并调控相变电子响应的实验范式，可为低维功能材料中的动态应变调控提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议分析声表面波频率、应变幅值和电荷密度波动力学之间的时间尺度匹配，并关注器件中衬底压电性和界面耦合的影响。可用第一性原理电子-声子计算或时间依赖输运模型定量连接应变、能带变化与声电流响应。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《与电荷密度波相变相关的声电流显著调制》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: uMOF: A Universal Database, Benchmark, and Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Metal-Organic Frameworks
full_list.title_zh: uMOF：面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、基准与机器学习原子间势
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, yet their promise for Metal-organic Frameworks (MOFs) remains largely unrealized as large unit cells make first-principles training data expensive to generate, fine-tuned models are scarce, and experimentally grounded benchmarks are scarcer still. We introduce uMOF, a three-part contribution addressing this gap. First, we release the largest and most accurate density functional theory dataset for MOFs to date, computed at the r²SCAN-D4 level of theory across 85524 configurations spanning 19950 unique frameworks and 79 elements, covering empty and gas-loaded structures, geometry optimizations, equations of state, and finite-temperature molecular dynamics. Second, we release a literature-mined benchmark of 3986 verified property values (3146 experimental) extracted from 626 papers by a seven-stage, checkpointed multi-pass large language model pipeline, linked to more than 650 crystallographic information files. Third, we release two universal MLIPs for MOFs, uMOF-MH and uMOF-POLAR, fine-tuned from two architecturally distinct MACE foundation models on the uMOF dataset. On near-equilibrium, ``Tier-1'' properties (bulk modulus, phonon-derived heat capacity) the uMOF models perform comparably to existing foundation and fine-tuned baselines. On harder, dynamics-sensitive properties like gas adsorption enthalpies via Widom insertion and adsorption isotherms, the uMOF models outperform every baseline we test, including MOF-specialized gas-capture models trained on datasets up to three orders of magnitude larger, cutting error by more than 80% to within experimental uncertainty. We trace this advantage to the physical diversity of the training data and to level of theory where a small (1.7%) fraction of MD simulations is decisive for MLIP stability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以远低于计算成本的代价实现接近第一性原理的精度，但其在金属有机框架（MOF）中的前景在很大程度上尚未实现，因为大晶胞使第一性原理训练数据的生成成本高昂，微调模型稀少，而以实验为依据的基准更为稀缺。我们提出uMOF，这是一项由三部分组成的工作，旨在填补这一空白。首先，我们发布了迄今规模最大、精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集：该数据集在r2SCAN-D4理论水平下计算，涵盖85524个构型、19950种不同框架和79种元素，包括空载与气体负载结构、几何优化、状态方程和有限温度分子动力学。第二，我们发布了一个通过文献挖掘建立的基准，其中包含由七阶段、带检查点的多轮大语言模型流程从626篇论文中提取的3986个经核验性质值，其中3146个为实验值，并与650多个晶体学信息文件相连接。第三，我们发布了两种面向MOF的通用MLIP，即uMOF-MH和uMOF-POLAR；它们是在uMOF数据集上，从两个架构不同的MACE基础模型微调而来。对于近平衡的“第一层级”性质，如体积模量和由声子导出的热容，uMOF模型的表现与现有基础模型和微调基线相当。对于更困难、对动力学敏感的性质，例如通过Widom插入计算的气体吸附焓和吸附等温线，uMOF模型优于我们测试的每一种基线，包括在规模大至三个数量级的数据集上训练的MOF专用气体捕集模型，将误差降低80%以上，达到实验不确定度范围内。我们将这一优势归因于训练数据的物理多样性和所采用的理论水平，其中仅占1.7%的分子动力学模拟对MLIP稳定性具有决定性作用。
full_list.summary: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。

Persson (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA)
full_list.focus_summary: 论文发布了面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、实验性质基准和机器学习原子间势。其数据集覆盖大量框架结构、气体负载构型、方程状态和有限温度分子动力学，并据此微调适用于 MOF 的机器学习势。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、材料数据库、主动学习和大规模分子动力学方法相关，但研究对象主要是金属有机框架，不属于团队当前重点材料体系。其数据集构建、实验基准关联和通用势微调策略可迁移到电池材料、钙钛矿或缺陷半导体研究。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可借鉴其数据集和基准测试流程，为 HfO2 铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、固态电解质和二维材料建立面向有限温度与缺陷的机器学习势。重点应评估势函数对相变、离子迁移、长程库仑作用和极化性质的描述能力。
full_list.method_point: uMOF构建了包含85,524个DFT构型、19,950种MOF和79种元素的数据集，并从626篇文献抽取核验的3,986个实验性质形成外部基准。作者训练两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势，除近平衡能量与力外，重点评估气体吸附焓和吸附等温线；这些性质要求势能面对孔道柔性、客体-骨架相互作用和热采样保持稳定。摘要未披露网络层数、色散修正、训练分割及系综参数，复现时必须查询正文而非臆定。
full_list.related_work: 它呼应MACE、NEP和equivariant GNN以跨化学空间预训练通用势的路线，但将评价重心从晶体结构优化转向吸附热力学，且采用文献实验基准约束实用性。与团队五位成员的高通量材料库、铁电软模、二维磁性、界面缺陷和主动学习势函数工作相连：共同难点是数据异质性与分布外构型，而MOF的开放孔道和客体扩散比BaTiO3或CrI3的致密晶格更严苛。其80%以上误差改善不能直接外推至磁交换或极化。
full_list.implication: 团队可仿照其双基准结构，为BaTiO3、NbOI2、CrI3和CrSBr建立“DFT构型库+实验性质表”：构型覆盖应变、畴壁、空位、层间位移和有限温快照，实验表纳入居里温度、介电响应、磁各向异性及拉曼模。用MACE或NEP分别训练基线与含主动学习模型，在NPT分子动力学中预测热膨胀、极化翻转势垒和层间交换，再以留出化学体系、DFT声子和温变XRD/MOKE验证，避免只报告训练集力误差。

full_list.title_en: Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.04907v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The optical and magneto-optical properties of thin epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga films, with thicknesses ranging from 8 to 160 nm, were investigated across the spectral range of 0.7-6.4 eV. The films were deposited by DC magnetron sputtering on MgO substrate with stress-mediating Cr buffer layer. Structural and magnetic characterization revealed an stress-induced martensitic transformation for the films thicker than 80 nm, while thinner films remained in austenite structure deformed by substrate constraint. Both X-type and Y-type twin domains were observed in martensitic samples. Magneto-optical polar Kerr effect spectra showed notable evolution with film thicknesses, demonstrating changes in electronic structure of Ni-Mn-Ga. A combination of spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical Kerr spectroscopy allowed for the deduction of the spectral dependence of full permittivity tensor of investigated samples. Three magneto-optical transitions were fitted to the spectra of non-diagonal permittivity using semiclassical theory, showing strong correlations with in-plane coercivity. Observed correlations highlight the impact of substrate-induced strain on Ni-Mn-Ga films and provide insights into the electronic structure changes associated with the martensitic transformation.

authors: M. Makeš, J. Zázvorka, M. Hubert, P. Veřtát, M. Rameš, J. Zemen, O. Heczko, M. Veis
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作实验研究外延Ni-Mn-Ga薄膜中的应力诱导马氏体相变，以及相变与光学、磁光性质之间的关联。通过椭偏和磁光克尔谱提取介电张量并分析电子结构变化，发现磁光跃迁与面内矫顽力具有显著相关性。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的磁性材料、磁结构、应变工程和光学响应研究相关，但该工作以薄膜实验表征为主。其应力驱动结构相变和磁光谱结果可为第一性原理计算磁各向异性、电子结构及光学张量提供验证对象。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可跟进计算不同应变和马氏体孪晶构型下的磁各向异性、交换作用及频率依赖介电张量。若研究磁弹耦合，可进一步构建含应变自由度的有效哈密顿量或自旋-晶格模型。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimensional potential energy surfaces from quantum chemical data, MLIPs enable accurate and efficient predictions of structural, thermodynamic, and dynamical properties. However, such models have limitations in predictions of electronic properties and the effects of static electron correlation due to their lack of electronic structure information. This work presents OrbGNN, an electronic structure graph architecture analogous to molecular graph and MLIP frameworks, where pair-orbital interactions constitute the graph representation, while orbital entanglement encodes the connectivity between them. By embedding information derived from orbital correlation metrics directly into the graph topology, OrbGNN provides a compact representation of a molecule s orbital landscape and electron correlation patterns. Analysis of the behavior of the feature space in an orbital graph are shown to demonstrate model robustness. The model is evaluated for the dissociation of nitrogen and for a larger dataset of diatomic molecules. Finally, the OrbGNN model is applied to a set of octahedral iron(II) complexes to predict spin-state energy gaps.
full_list.summary: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimension…
authors: Brody Quebedeaux, Shahzad Akram, Markus Reiher, Konstantinos D. Vogiatzis
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作提出OrbGNN，通过以轨道对相互作用为边、以轨道纠缠信息定义连通性的图表示，刻画分子电子关联和轨道结构。模型在氮分子解离等任务上用于分析电子关联特征空间及其鲁棒性。
full_list.focus_relation: 该工作与团队发展的图神经网络、电子结构机器学习及机器学习哈密顿量方向存在方法学关联，但当前主要面向分子量子化学而非凝聚态材料。其显式编码轨道关联的表示方式，可能为强关联材料电子结构学习提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其轨道相关性度量如何构造图拓扑，以及该表示是否满足晶体平移、点群和自旋对称性。可探索将局域轨道、Wannier基和自旋轨道耦合信息纳入模型，用于固体Kohn-Sham哈密顿量或相关电子性质预测。
full_list.method_point: OrbGNN提出以波函数为基础的机器学习电子间表示，意图突破传统MLIP主要依赖核坐标、局域邻接图和总能量标签的限制。根据摘要，它从量子化学波函数中提取电子相关信息，再用图神经网络形成可学习的interelectronic representation，用于势能面及结构、热力学和动力学预测；但摘要未公开输入张量是轨道系数、密度矩阵还是二电子积分，也未给出等变性、复杂度和训练数据，不能杜撰架构细节。
full_list.related_work: 该方向可与SchNet、PaiNN、NequIP、MACE等几何等变势对照：后者通常从元素和坐标学习有效电子作用，OrbGNN试图把波函数层面的电子关联显式注入。它也接近DFT中Wannier函数、密度矩阵和轨道占据作为描述符的路线。团队五位成员的ML势、强关联DFT、二维磁性、铁电极化和器件输运工作分别能提供结构动力学、轨道标签、交换各向异性、极化电荷和哈密顿量检验场景。
full_list.implication: 不宜直接将OrbGNN用于大尺度BaTiO3或CrI3分子动力学；先在小胞上生成DFT+U或混合泛函的Wannier哈密顿量、局域密度矩阵、Born电荷和交换参数，并与仅坐标输入的MACE作严格消融。首个任务可选NbOI2极化相、CrSBr层间位移和氧空位BaTiO3，训练/测试按结构族和应变留出。验证除能量力外，应比较带隙、Berry相极化、磁各向异性及NEGF透射，只有电子性质外推改善才证明波函数表征的额外成本合理。

full_list.title_en: Observation of subharmonic charge-density-wave correlations in La-based cuprates
full_list.title_zh: La基铜酸盐中次谐波电荷密度波关联的观测
full_list.abstract: Author(s): J.-S. Lee, S. A. Kivelson, H. Lee, T. Wang, Y. Ikeda, T. Taniguchi, C.-T. Kuo, M. Fujita, and C.-C. Kao Suggestive but indirect evidence for pair-density-wave correlations has been reported in several high- T c cuprates, yet a bulk-sensitive scattering signature of the expected subharmonic charge response has remained elusive. Here, the authors use resonant soft x-ray scattering to identify a reproducible subharmonic charge density wave response near half the primary charge-ordering wave vector in two La-based cuprates. The response emerges in the stripe-ordered, layer-decoupled superconducting regime, where charge, spin, and superconducting correlations are intertwined. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 074514] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Quantum geometric bounds at finite temperature for one-dimensional chiral systems
full_list.title_zh: 一维手征系统有限温度下的量子几何界
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry and topology of quantum states are intimately related at zero temperature through exact bounds that constrain geometric quantities from below by topological invariants. At finite-temperature, however, the analogous relations remain unclear. Here we establish rigorous geometric lower bounds for one-dimensional (1D) chiral-symmetric systems at finite temperature within the Uhlmann's framework for mixed states. We show that the Bures length is bounded by a continuous geometric phase angle. We further derive a temperature-dependent bound that interpolates between the zero-temperature limit and a trivial high-temperature regime. Our results are verified analytically and numerically using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model and the spinless Kitaev chain model. Finally, we discuss potential ways to detect the geometry of the density matrix in quantum circuits, with the quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) method.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文在混态的Uhlmann框架下，建立了一维手征对称系统有限温度下的严格几何下界。研究证明Bures长度受连续几何相位角约束，并导出一个连接零温极限与平凡高温区域的温度依赖界。SSH模型和无自旋Kitaev链的解析与数值结果验证了该理论，并讨论了通过量子虚时间演化测量密度矩阵几何的方法。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在零温下，量子态的几何与拓扑通过精确界限密切相关，这些界限利用拓扑不变量从下方约束几何量。然而，在有限温度下，相应关系仍不清楚。本文在混态的Uhlmann框架内，为一维（1D）手征对称系统建立了严格的有限温度几何下界。我们表明，Bures长度受一个连续几何相位角的下界约束。我们进一步导出了一个温度依赖的界，该界在零温极限与平凡的高温区域之间插值。我们利用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型和无自旋Kitaev链模型，从解析和数值两方面验证了结果。最后，我们讨论了利用量子虚时间演化（QITE）方法在量子电路中探测密度矩阵几何的潜在途径。

full_list.title_en: Universal Hamiltonian simulators in one and two dimensions
full_list.title_zh: 一维和二维中的通用哈密顿量模拟器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2102.02991v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A major quantum computing application is analog Hamiltonian simulations, in which the low-lying spectrum of a simulator Hamiltonian H' encodes the physics of a target Hamiltonian H. Some families of 2D spin-lattice Hamiltonians---such as the Heisenberg or XY model on the square lattice---are known to be ``universal'' simulators, in the sense that they can simulate any target Hamiltonian. Unfortunately, while the known simulations of 1D or 2D target Hamiltonians are efficient, they require resources growing exponentially with system sizes for target Hamiltonians with general connectivity. This leaves many important cases such as 3D or all-to-all-connected target Hamiltonians out of reach in practice. Here we remedy this situation and show how the known 2D universal families of Hamiltonians and a new 1D family can simulate all target local Hamiltonians, with only polynomial-scaling overhead. This exponential improvement is achieved by a nonperturbative method combining the quantum phase-estimation algorithm and the circuit-to-Hamiltonian construction. Furthermore, all Hamiltonians efficiently simulable by quantum circuits, including nonlocal ones, also have efficient analog simulators in our 2D and 1D universal families. Our work establishes that analog simulations of general Hamiltonians can be made efficient, significantly expanding the application potential of analog Hamiltonian simulations in near-term quantum technologies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 模拟器哈密顿量的低能谱可编码目标哈密顿量的物理性质，但既有一维或二维方案在处理一般连接结构时需要指数增长的资源。本文表明，已知的二维通用哈密顿量族及一个新的一维哈密顿量族可用多项式开销模拟所有局域目标哈密顿量。该方法结合量子相位估计算法与电路到哈密顿量构造，并将高效模拟的范围扩展到可由量子电路高效模拟的非局域哈密顿量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算的一项重要应用是模拟哈密顿量，其中模拟器哈密顿量 H' 的低能谱编码了目标哈密顿量 H 的物理性质。某些二维自旋晶格哈密顿量族，例如方格晶格上的海森堡模型或 XY 模型，已知是“通用”模拟器，即它们能够模拟任意目标哈密顿量。遗憾的是，尽管已知的一维或二维目标哈密顿量模拟是高效的，但对于具有一般连接结构的目标哈密顿量，它们所需资源会随系统尺寸呈指数增长。这使得许多重要情形，例如三维或全连接目标哈密顿量，在实践中难以处理。这里我们解决了这一问题，并说明已知的二维通用哈密顿量族以及一个新的一维哈密顿量族如何仅以多项式标度的开销模拟所有目标局域哈密顿量。这种指数级改进通过一种结合量子相位估计算法和电路到哈密顿量构造的非微扰方法实现。此外，所有能够由量子电路高效模拟的哈密顿量，包括非局域哈密顿量，也都能在我们的二维和一维通用哈密顿量族中得到高效的模拟器。我们的工作确立了对一般哈密顿量的模拟可以实现高效，从而显著拓展了模拟哈密顿量在近期量子技术中的应用潜力。

full_list.title_en: A Schwinger-Keldysh Formulation of Semiclassical Operator Dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 半经典算符动力学的 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.02106v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work we develop a real-time Schwinger-Keldysh formulation of Krylov dynamics that treats Krylov complexity as an in-in observable generated by a closed time contour path integral. The resulting generating functional exposes an emergent phase-space description in which the Lanczos coefficients define an effective Hamiltonian governing operator motion along the Krylov chain. In the semiclassical limit, exponential complexity growth arises from hyperbolic trajectories, and asymptotically linear Lanczos growth appears as a universal chaotic fixed point, with sub-leading deformations classified as irrelevant, marginal or relevant. Going beyond the saddle, the Schwinger-Keldysh framework provides controlled access to fluctuations and large deviations of Krylov complexity, revealing sharp signatures of integrability-chaos crossovers that are invisible at the level of the mean. This formulation reorganises Krylov complexity into a dynamical field-theoretic framework and identifies new fluctuation diagnostics of operator growth in closed quantum systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文发展了 Krylov 动力学的实时 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述，将 Krylov 复杂度作为由闭合时间轮廓路径积分生成的 in-in 观测量处理。该框架中，Lanczos 系数定义控制 Krylov 链上算符运动的有效哈密顿量；在半经典极限下，双曲轨道导致复杂度指数增长，渐近线性 Lanczos 增长对应普适混沌不动点。该形式还可受控地研究复杂度涨落和大偏差，并揭示平均值分析无法观测的可积性至混沌交叉特征。

full_list.title_en: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to 300 × over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.

full_list.title_en: Higher-Order Topological Phase in the Two-Dimensional Type-IV Magnet MgCr₂O₄
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Higher-Order Topological Phase in the Two-Dimensional Type-IV Magnet MgCr₂O₄
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Type-IV two-dimensional (2D) magnetism-a newly classified collinear magnetic phase featuring nonrelativistic spin degeneracy and spin-orbit-coupling-induced momentum-dependent spin splitting-extends the symmetry classification of collinear magnets, opening new opportunities for unconventional topological quantum states. Here, we reveal that the recently proposed two-dimensional type-IV 2D magnet MgCr₂O₄ hosts an intrinsic higher-order topological insulating phase, featuring C₃z-protected corner states and a nontrivial rotational topological invariant of χ⁽³⁾ = -2,4 with a quantized fractional corner charge of 4e/3. Spin-orbit coupling breaks the spin-degeneracy-enforcing symmetry [C₂||M_z] while preserving the crystalline C₃z rotational symmetry that protects the higher-order topological phase, thereby enabling spin splitting to coexist with the nontrivial topology. Furthermore, the higher-order topological phase remains intact throughout a wide range of biaxial strains without band-gap closing and topological phase transition, demonstrating the robustness of the symmetry-protected topological state against external perturbations. Our work establishes a direct connection between type-IV magnetic system and higher-order topology, providing a new route for symmetry-engineered magnetic topological quantum states.

full_list.title_en: Strong electron correlations and ligand hybridization for altermagnetism
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Strong electron correlations and ligand hybridization for altermagnetism
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.14248v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-band splitting is a hallmark of altermagnetism, intrinsically linked to magnetic ordering driven by electron correlations. However, recent inconsistencies in the detection of altermagnetism in strongly correlated altermagnet candidates have cast doubt on the robustness of this phenomenon and its dependence on many-body effects. Here, density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT), we dissect the electronic origins of altermagnetism in three prototypical candidates: MnF₂, MnTe, and RuO₂. In MnF₂, we identify pronounced local electron correlations within Mn-3d states and uncover a distinct Mott gap in the visible range. The strong correlations markedly localize the Mn-3d electrons, leading to a narrowing of the spin-resolved bandwidth and, consequently, a suppression of spin-band splitting. By contrast, MnTe provides an ideal platform for altermagnetism, exhibiting substantial local Mn-3d magnetic moments due to the strong correlations and pronounced spin-band splitting, enabled by robust Mn-3d--Te-5p orbital hybridization. RuO₂ manifests as a Pauli paramagnet with vanishing local moments, even in its antiferromagnetic phase. Nonetheless, it exhibits significant spin-band splitting, indicative of itinerant altermagnetic behavior. Our results reveal that both strong local electron correlations and judicious ligand selection to promote orbital hybridization are key prerequisites to realizing altermagnetism in strongly correlated systems. These insights pave the way for the rational design and discovery of novel altermagnetic materials.

full_list.title_en: First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO₃ under Electric Boundary Conditions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO₃ under Electric Boundary Conditions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric and antiferroelectric phases of LiTaO₃ compete under different electric boundary conditions. First-principles density-functional calculations show that the high-symmetry reference structure supports two relevant unstable Γ modes: a polar A₂ᵤ mode at 181i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the ferroelectric (FE) phase, and an antipolar A₂g mode at 103i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the antiferroelectric (AFE) phase. Under short-circuit conditions the FE phase is the global minimum, with a well depth of approx 144 meV. Under open-circuit conditions the FE phase is destabilized by the unscreened depolarization field and the AFE phase becomes the ground state, with a well depth of approx 19 meV. A weakly unstable longitudinal-optic mode at 48.3i cm⁻¹ yields a well of only approx 0.24 meV and is thermodynamically irrelevant. Mapping the free energy versus electric displacement D locates a second-order FE↔AFE transition at D_c=0.051 C/m², lower than the corresponding 0.07 C/m² in LiNbO₃ and therefore more accessible experimentally.

full_list.title_en: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility χ⁽¹⁾. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through χ⁽¹⁾. After a general discussion of χ⁽¹⁾ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn₃XN (X= Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the Γ₅g phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of χ⁽¹⁾ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of χ⁽¹⁾ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.

full_list.title_en: Simplified criteria for identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Simplified criteria for identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.27151v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetism is a compensated magnetic phase characterized by zero net magnetization and exchange-driven spin splitting. However, identifying altermagnets among collinear antiferromagnets usually requires full magnetic-space-group or spin-group analysis, which is not always intuitive. Here we formulate a simple real-space criterion based on how the crystallographic operations of the host nonmagnetic structure permute the two opposite-spin sublattices. We show that altermagnets usually exist on collinear compensated antiferromagnets whose magnetic primitive cell coincides with the host nonmagnetic crystallographic primitive cell. In this case, altermagnetic spin splitting is generally allowed unless an inversion-type operation exists that exchanges the two opposite-spin sublattices. Using chemically ordered Mn2SSe prototypes derived from zinc-blende or rocksalt parent structures, we demonstrate that these criteria can be easily used to construct the three symmetry classes by controlling chemical ordering and magnetic-sublattice permutation. Similar rules can also be applied to low-dimensional crystals or quasicrystals. Our work reduces the identification of altermagnets to a transparent real-space symmetry test and provides a practical route for designing altermagnetic crystals.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.17842v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic behavior across Fe₂O₃ polymorphs varies widely despite identical chemistry, highlighting crystal architecture as a key determinant of exchange topology, magnetic anisotropy, and ultimately magnetic order. Here, using neutron and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we establish the magnetic ground state of the poorly understood bixbyite β-Fe₂O₃ polymorph and uncover the structural origin of its strong frustration. Below the Néel temperature, a noncollinear antiferromagnetic state emerges through activation of the mH₁⁺ irrep at the H-point [k=(1,1,1)] and the antitranslation (1'|tfrac12,tfrac12,tfrac12), breaking the body centering and yielding two interpenetrating primitive cubic magnetic subcells with inverted moments and nonpolar type-IV symmetry. Under exclusively antiferromagnetic Fe³⁺-O-Fe³⁺ interactions, β-Fe₂O₃ exhibits a large frustration index (f approx 7.56). This behavior originates from the intrinsic geometry of the bixbyite lattice: two magnetic sublattices with distinct point symmetries and anisotropy constraints are embedded in a three-dimensional exchange network containing interconnected triangular and hexagonal motifs. In 111 planes, Fe2 ions form hexagonal rings interconnected by frustrated triangular units, while locally Ising-like Fe1 ions occupy the ring centers. Our results thus identify the bixbyite architecture as a promising general platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism. Extending this structural framework to other magnetic transition-metal or 4f ions opens a materials space for engineering competing exchange interactions and anisotropies, potentially stabilizing new noncollinear and field-tunable magnetic states.

full_list.focus_summary: 论文结合中子衍射和同步辐射X射线衍射，确定了β-Fe₂O₃的非共线反铁磁基态。研究指出，bixbyite晶格中的三角形和六边形交换网络、不同磁性子晶格的对称性及各向异性共同导致强磁挫折。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋哈密顿量、交换相互作用和对称性分析方向高度相关。该工作可为研究晶体结构如何调控磁挫折、磁序和磁各向异性提供重要案例。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可利用第一性原理计算提取β-Fe₂O₃的交换参数、单离子各向异性和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，并构建自旋哈密顿量研究温度依赖磁相变。还可考察应变、缺陷和外场对非共线磁序的调控。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《The bixbyite framework as a platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism: resolving the magnetic ground state of β-Fe₂O₃》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite significant progress in the study of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), the chiral C₄T-protected HOTI has remained elusive in electronic materials, where C₄T denotes the product of a four-fold rotation and time-reversal symmetry. We show that altermagnetism, a recently discovered form of collinear magnetism, provides a new route to realize this elusive phase. Specifically, we construct a microscopic model that combines a three-dimensional topological insulator with a collinear d-wave altermagnet on a Lieb lattice. Through analytical and numerical calculations, we show that the magnetism shifts and gaps the surface Dirac cones to produce the desired chiral hinge channels. Finally, we identify promising material classes to realise our proposal. Our results establish collinear altermagnetism as a route to intrinsic chiral higher-order topology and open a new path toward the discovery of C₄T-protected HOTIs in real materials.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Geometric Origin of Nonlinear Current Induced Orbital Magnetization
full_list.title_zh: 非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric generation of magnetization is a focus of condensed matter research, and has recently been advanced into the nonlinear regime. However, due to the nonlocal nature of orbital magnetism, how to properly formulate nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we develop the proper theory for this effect. This is based on the microscopic derivation of field-corrected orbital magnetic moment of a Bloch electron, a critical missing piece in the present theory. We show that the quantum geometric origin of this phenomenon lies in both the anomalous orbital polarizability and the Berry-connection polarizability, which often provide competing contributions. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict significant, experimentally accessible nonlinear orbital magnetization generated in strained bilayer graphene, monolayer 1T' MoS₂ and MoTe₂. Remarkably, nonlinear orbital magnetization can dominate over its spin counterpart in materials with topological band features, irrespective of the spin-orbit coupling strength.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文建立了非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，核心是对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导。研究表明，该现象源于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率，两者通常会产生相互竞争的贡献。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测了应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′-MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中显著且可实验观测的非线性轨道磁化。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电场产生磁化是凝聚态物理研究的一个重点，并且近年来已经拓展到非线性领域。然而，由于轨道磁性的非局域性，如何恰当地表述非线性电流诱导轨道磁化仍然是一个基本挑战。在此，我们建立了该效应的适当理论。该理论建立在对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导之上，而这一内容是现有理论中关键的缺失环节。我们表明，这一现象的量子几何起源同时存在于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率之中，二者通常会提供相互竞争的贡献。我们将该理论与第一性原理计算相结合，预测了在应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′ MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中能够产生显著且实验上可实现的非线性轨道磁化。值得注意的是，在具有拓扑能带特征的材料中，无论自旋-轨道耦合强度如何，非线性轨道磁化都可能超过其自旋对应项。
full_list.summary: 本文建立了非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，核心是对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导。研究表明，该现象源于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率，两者通常会产生相互竞争的贡献。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测了应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′-MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中显著且可实验观测的非线性轨道磁化。
authors: Xue-Jin Zhang, Yue-Xin Huang, Wei Du, Xiaolong Feng, Shen Lai, Cong Xiao, Qian Niu, Shengyuan A. Yang
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作建立非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，推导包含外场修正轨道磁矩的微观表达式，并指出反常轨道极化率和Berry联络极化率是其量子几何来源。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测应变双层石墨烯、单层1T' MoS2和MoTe2中存在显著且可实验观测的非线性轨道磁化。
full_list.focus_relation: 该工作与团队的二维材料、范德华体系、磁电耦合、拓扑性质、非线性光电响应和第一性原理计算方向高度相关。其将量子几何量与可测磁响应建立联系，可拓展团队对铁电、铁谷和拓扑界面体系中电场调控磁性的研究。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议重点核查其第一性原理实现中Berry相位、轨道磁矩和费米面项的数值收敛方案。可将该理论应用于滑移铁电双层、范德华磁体及交替磁体，研究极化翻转或堆垛切换对非线性轨道磁化符号和强度的调控。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Fractionalization, emergent SU(N) symmetries, and fragmentation in layered quantum spin-orbital models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fractionalization, emergent SU(N) symmetries, and fragmentation in layered quantum spin-orbital models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.22908v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a family of layered quantum spin-orbital models as a platform to study fractionalization, unconventional forms of symmetry-breaking order, and their possible coexistence. The models are built by stacking N layers of a square-lattice system in which Kitaev-type interactions promote the formation of a Z₂ quantum spin-orbital liquid and coupling the different layers via Ising spin interactions. Using a parton construction, we show how, at low energies, these Hamiltonians can be mapped to N-component Fermi Hubbard models on a π-flux square lattice at half filling. We also demonstrate that the models acquire an emergent SU(N) symmetry in the limit of equal all-to-all interlayer couplings and argue that, for N>2, the proximity to this limit offers the potential to realize an array of competing phases. To illustrate this point, we compute the zero-temperature phase diagram of the effective N=3 Hubbard model within mean-field theory and uncover rich phenomena, including intertwined orders and flavor-selective localization. Mapping back to the original degrees of freedom reveals that the ground states realize distinct forms of magnetic fragmentation, wherein the orbitals remain in a quantum liquid state whereas the spins can present conventional long-range order or nonlocal order characterized by a nontrivial string order parameters. We highlight possible extensions of our construction as well as its potential to provide concrete microscopic models for different fractionalized quantum critical points.

full_list.title_en: Interplay of Quasiperiodicity, Hubbard Interactions, and Staggered Magnetism in a 1D Ring: Localization and Re-entrant Characteristics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interplay of Quasiperiodicity, Hubbard Interactions, and Staggered Magnetism in a 1D Ring: Localization and Re-entrant Characteristics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.29177v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study interaction-induced localization in a spinful quasiperiodic Hubbard ring with quasiperiodically modulated hopping and a staggered spin-dependent Zeeman field using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock approach. We characterize localization through the inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, and multifractal analysis, and further examine its signatures in self-consistent real-space observables, including double occupancy, density fluctuations, local entropy, spin-density-wave order, and related correlation measures. As the Hubbard interaction is increased, we find a nonmonotonic evolution of the eigenstates: an initially extended regime gives way to an intermediate localized phase, followed by reentrant delocalization at stronger interactions. The width of this intermediate regime grows systematically with both the quasiperiodic hopping amplitude and the staggered Zeeman-field strength, indicating a cooperative enhancement of localization by these two ingredients. In the localized regime, the self-consistent interaction produces pronounced spin dependence in both the spectra and localization properties, resulting in distinct responses of the spin-up and spin-down sectors. The interaction-driven crossover is consistently captured by the real-space observables and further corroborated by real-time wave-packet dynamics, which reveal successive ballistic, confined, and reentrant-transport regimes consistent with the underlying eigenstate character. These results provide a unified framework for understanding the interplay of quasiperiodicity, electronic interactions, and spin-dependent fields in controlling localization, criticality, and quantum transport in correlated quasiperiodic systems.

full_list.focus_summary: 论文研究了具有准周期跃迁、Hubbard相互作用和交错自旋塞曼场的一维自洽平均场模型。结果显示，体系随相互作用增强经历从延展态到局域态再到再入延展态的非单调演化，并伴随明显的自旋依赖谱和自旋密度波特征。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队关注的磁性材料、自旋相互作用、有效哈密顿量、局域化和蒙特卡洛模拟有中等相关性。其自洽Hartree-Fock框架和局域观测量分析可为构建准周期磁性体系的自旋模型提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究该模型中自旋轨道耦合、非共线磁序或电子-声子耦合对再入局域化的影响。也可将其推广到二维磁性超晶格或莫尔体系，并与第一性原理得到的有效参数结合。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Interplay of Quasiperiodicity, Hubbard Interactions, and Staggered Magnetism in a 1D Ring: Localization and Re-entrant Characteristics》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Two-dimensional quantum Griffith singularity in three-dimensional ZrNₓ superconducting films
full_list.title_zh: 三维 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中的二维量子 Griffith 奇异性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the experimental observation of two-dimensional (2D) quantum Griffiths singularity (QGS) in sim200-nm-thick epitaxial ZrNₓ superconducting films. The films possess a rock-salt structure and are three-dimensional (3D) with respect to superconductivity. For each film with x gtrsim 1.30, the low-temperature magnetoresistance isotherms under fields perpendicular and parallel to the film plane cross over at a broad magnetic field range independently rather than at a single crossing point. Despite the macroscopic 3D nature of the superconductivity, the magnetoresistance isotherms at selected adjacent temperatures follow the theoretical prediction of power-law scaling for 2D superconducting systems, rather than that for 3D systems. The effective critical exponent zν, obtained by analyzing the magnetoresistance isotherms using the 2D power-law scaling, increases with decreasing temperature and diverges as the quantum phase transition is approached. In addition, the resistivity data near the superconductor-insulator or superconductor-metal transitions obey an activated scaling form that describes the quantum phase transition of 2D superconducting systems governed by an infinite-randomness critical point. The QGS in the ZrNₓ films is attributed to quenched disorder induced by intrinsic defects, such as Zr vacancies and N interstitials, which creates spatially inhomogeneous superconducting rare regions. The dynamics of these rare regions, which may exhibit effective 2D characteristics near the quantum critical point, dominate the transport properties of the system near the quantum phase transition. Our results provide compelling evidence for the existence of QGS in 3D superconductors and highlight the crucial role of disorder-induced inhomogeneity in determining the critical behavior of quantum phase transitions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子 Griffith 奇异性。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维特征，磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度，并显示出趋近量子相变时发散的有效临界指数。研究将这一现象归因于本征缺陷引起的淬灭无序及其形成的空间非均匀超导稀有区域。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中报告了二维（2D）量子 Griffith 奇异性（QGS）的实验观测结果。这些薄膜具有岩盐结构，并且就超导性而言属于三维（3D）体系。对于每一片 x 大于或约等于 1.30 的薄膜，在低温下，垂直于薄膜平面和平行于薄膜平面的磁场所对应的磁阻等温线，会在一个较宽的磁场范围内分别发生交叉，而不是在单一交叉点处交叉。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维性质，但选定的相邻温度下的磁阻等温线遵循二维超导系统幂律标度的理论预言，而不是三维系统的理论预言。通过使用二维幂律标度分析磁阻等温线得到的有效临界指数 zν 随温度降低而增大，并在接近量子相变时发散。此外，超导体-绝缘体或超导体-金属转变附近的电阻率数据遵循一种激活标度形式，该形式描述了由无穷随机性临界点支配的二维超导系统量子相变。ZrNₓ 薄膜中的 QGS 被归因于本征缺陷（例如 Zr 空位和 N 间隙原子）所诱导的淬灭无序，这些缺陷形成了空间上不均匀的超导稀有区域。这些稀有区域的动力学在量子临界点附近可能表现出有效的二维特征，并在量子相变附近主导体系的输运性质。我们的结果为三维超导体中存在 QGS 提供了有力证据，并突出了无序诱导的非均匀性在决定量子相变临界行为中的关键作用。
full_list.summary: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子 Griffith 奇异性。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维特征，磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度，并显示出趋近量子相变时发散的有效临界指数。研究将这一现象归因于本征缺陷引起的淬灭无序及其形成的空间非均匀超导稀有区域。

full_list.title_en: Bad Metal Behavior and Lifshitz Transition of a Nagaoka Ferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bad Metal Behavior and Lifshitz Transition of a Nagaoka Ferromagnet
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.01909v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using an extension of the fermionic functional renormalization group for systems where strong correlations give rise to projected Hilbert spaces we calculate the phase diagram and the electronic spectral function of the Hubbard model at infinite on-site repulsion. For a square lattice with nearest-neighbor hopping we find that the ground state evolves from a paramagnetic Fermi liquid at low densities via a state with antiferromagnetic stripe order at intermediate densities to an extended Nagaoka ferromagnet at high densities. The single-particle spectral function of the Nagaoka ferromagnet exhibits a flat but rather broad band characteristic for an incoherent non-Fermi liquid. We identify two distinct ferromagnetic regimes separated by a Lifshitz transition.

full_list.title_en: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) integrate terrestrial and aerial platforms to provide ubiquitous communication, sensing, and localization services for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. However, dynamic air-ground and air-air channels, abrupt blockages, and heterogeneous interference hinder the realization of this goal. Nevertheless, fluid antenna (FA), a cutting-edge multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technique, overcomes these challenges by reconfiguring antenna positions to unlock additional spatial degrees-of-freedom. In this paper, towards bringing low-altitude FA networks into reality, we study the fast and high-performance FA reconfiguration for low-altitude FA networks with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Specifically, we present an electromagnetic digital twin (EM-DT)-assisted MARL framework. To fill the sim-to-real gap, we introduce a two-stage transfer learning framework. Our case study shows that joint FA positions and beamforming optimization can enhance the system sum-rate by 118.5%, compared to the fixed position baseline. This gain comes from the dynamic millisecond timescale reconfiguration of FA arrays and the adaptive steering of beams toward aerial users with mobility.

full_list.title_en: Magnetoelasticity in Fe/GaAs(110) films: Depth profile of magnetic anisotropy
full_list.title_zh: Fe/GaAs(110) 薄膜中的磁弹性：磁各向异性的深度分布
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Aleksandra Lindner, Rodolfo A. Gallardo, Andreas Henschke, Fabian Ganss, Javier Pablo-Navarro, Gabriel Gray, Ruslan Salikhov, Kilian Lenz, Toni Hache, Dirk Sander, Gauravkumar Patel, Sebastian Fähler, Olav Hellwig, Jürgen Fassbender, and Jürgen Lindner The authors report here the coexistence of cubic and uniaxial magnetic anisotropies in thick epitaxial bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) films, with the latter having a magnitude comparable to that of the former. Their interplay stabilizes an in-plane easy axis along the ⟨001⟩ directions that persists throughout the film volume for thicknesses up to 100 nm. This unconventional behavior gives rise to a depth-dependent magnetic response, with perpendicular standing spin-wave modes exhibiting distinct sensitivities to different regions of the film thickness. The study further identifies anisotropic strain as the microscopic origin of the observed in-plane uniaxial anisotropy. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094438] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究报道了厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中立方和单轴磁各向异性的共存，二者共同稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴。该非常规行为导致磁响应随薄膜深度而变化，不同垂直驻波自旋波模式对膜厚不同区域的敏感性不同。研究还确定各向异性应变是面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Aleksandra Lindner、Rodolfo A. Gallardo、Andreas Henschke、Fabian Ganss、Javier Pablo-Navarro、Gabriel Gray、Ruslan Salikhov、Kilian Lenz、Toni Hache、Dirk Sander、Gauravkumar Patel、Sebastian Fähler、Olav Hellwig、Jürgen Fassbender 和 Jürgen Lindner。作者在此报道，在厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中，立方磁各向异性和单轴磁各向异性共存，后者的量级可与前者相当。它们之间的相互作用稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴，对于厚度最高达 100 nm 的薄膜，这一易轴贯穿整个膜体积而保持存在。这种非常规行为导致了随深度变化的磁响应，垂直驻波自旋波模式对薄膜厚度不同区域表现出不同的敏感性。该研究进一步确定，各向异性应变是观测到的面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。[《Physical Review B》114，094438]，发表于 2026 年 8 月 31 日。
